React Native Developer Intern

Zoho CRM Expert

Lahore , Pakistan

Apply Now

Posted 5 days ago 20 views Report Job

  • Job Description
  • About Company
  • Rozee Premium
  • Share this job
    • Copy
    • WhatsApp

    • Facebook
    • Twitter
    • Email to friend

We are looking for a motivated React Native Developer Intern who is eager to gain hands-on experience in building, testing, debugging, and maintaining mobile applications. This internship offers the opportunity to work closely with an experienced development team on real-world projects, enhancing practical skills in React Native and associated technologies. The role involves learning and contributing to various stages of mobile app development, from coding to deployment.

Key Responsibilities
- Assist in developing and maintaining mobile applications using React Native.
- Collaborate with the development team to implement new features and improvements.
- Integrate RESTful APIs and backend services.
- Help debug and resolve application issues.
- Test applications to identify bugs and performance bottlenecks.
- Gain experience working with Android Studio and Gradle.
- Support the generation of APK and AAB builds for testing and release.
- Assist with application versioning, signing configurations, and build variants.
- Obtain practical exposure to Google Play Console and app deployment processes.
- Follow coding standards and maintain code quality.
- Use Git/GitHub for source code management.
- Maintain basic technical documentation for assigned tasks.
- Perform other development-related tasks as assigned by senior developers or management.

Required Qualifications
- Currently pursuing or recently completed a Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field.
- Basic understanding of React Native and JavaScript (ES6+) or TypeScript.
- Familiarity with React concepts and Hooks.
- Basic knowledge of Android Studio and Gradle, including app and project-level build.gradle files.
- Understanding of versioning, signing configurations, and build variants is a plus.
- Basic knowledge of generating APK and AAB files (debug and release).
- Basic understanding of Google Play Store deployment processes.
- Experience or exposure to RESTful APIs using Axios or Fetch.
- Basic knowledge of state management tools such as Redux or Context API.
- Good debugging and problem-solving skills.
- Willingness to learn testing and performance optimization techniques.
- Basic experience with Git and GitHub.
- Ability to learn independently and complete tasks within deadlines.
- Assist in integrating APIs and backend services, fixing bugs, and improving application performance.
- Maintain clean code and basic documentation.

Preferred Qualifications and Benefits
- Basic knowledge of Firebase services, including Authentication, Push Notifications, or Crashlytics.
- Familiarity with Google Play Console and app signing processes.
- Experience with previously developed React Native or other mobile applications.
- Published mobile applications on the Google Play Store.
- Basic understanding of Continuous Integration/Continuous Deployment (CI/CD) for mobile applications.
- Awareness of Play Store policies and app submission requirements.

This internship is an in-person position, providing a valuable opportunity for fresh graduates and students with foundational React Native knowledge to grow their skills in a professional environment focused on mobile app development.
